function.name: get_balance
function.description: Retrieves the current account balance for the authenticated user. Use this for any balance, available funds, or account overview query.

account_id.description: The account identifier (optional — defaults to the user's primary account)

function.name: get_transactions
function.description: Retrieves recent transaction history for the authenticated user. Use this when the user asks about spending, recent activity, or transaction history.

limit.description: Number of transactions to retrieve. Default: 10, max: 50.

function.name: verify_payee
function.description: Runs a Verification of Payee (VoP) check against the Open Banking registry. ALWAYS call this before any execute_transfer call. Returns MATCH, CLOSE_MATCH, or NO_MATCH with a confidence score.

provided_name.description: Payee name as provided by the user

registered_name.description: Expected registered name at the receiving bank (may equal provided_name initially)

sort_code.description: Target sort code in format XX-XX-XX

function.name: execute_transfer
function.description: REQUIRES USER CONFIRMATION. Initiates a payment transfer to an external payee via Open Banking. This is a STATE-MUTATING action — it triggers the Confirm-Before-Action gate and will NOT execute until the user explicitly confirms via the /api/actions/confirm endpoint.

payee_name.description: Full name of the payment recipient

sort_code.description: Recipient sort code in format XX-XX-XX

function.name: set_budget_alert
function.description: REQUIRES USER CONFIRMATION. Sets a monthly budget spending alert threshold for a category. This is a STATE-MUTATING action that triggers the Confirm-Before-Action gate.

alert_threshold_percent.description: Alert when spending reaches this percentage of the limit (default: 80)

function.name: flag_transaction
function.description: Flags a specific transaction for review or dispute. Use when the user reports a suspicious or incorrect transaction.

reason.description: Reason for flagging the transaction (e.g. 'Unauthorised charge', 'Incorrect amount')

function.name: rag_lookup
function.description: Retrieves relevant information from the AI Financial Guardian knowledge base. Use this to answer questions about banking regulations, Open Banking policies, dispute processes, or security procedures.

query.description: The question or topic to look up in the knowledge base
